title: ABB Introduces AI Robot Vision Tool That Cuts Commissioning Time by Up to 90%, Cycle Times by Up to 50%
key_facts: ABB Robotics expanded its OmniCore EyeMotion robot vision technology with a new tool, AI Robot Trainer, announced from Auburn Hills, Michigan.
ABB says the tool reduces commissioning time by up to 90% and cycle times by up to 50% in automated manufacturing.
It lets manufacturers and system integrators train, deploy and keep improving AI-powered robot vision without special AI-model expertise.
It links image capture, AI model training, deployment and ongoing improvement in one workflow, with automatic collision-free path planning, a guided workflow and an AI chatbot.
It uses synthetic and real-world image data and works with cameras and sensors from different makers.
Uses: 2D pick-and-place, 3D bin picking, quality inspection, sorting and assembly.
Marc Segura, president of ABB Robotics, said robotic AI vision is the bridge between robot perception and physical actions.
quote_evidence: ABB Robotics has expanded its OmniCore EyeMotion robot vision technology with AI Robot Trainer, a new tool designed to reduce commissioning time by up to 90% and cycle times by up to 50% in automated manufacturing applications.
Applications range from 2D pick-and-place operations to more complex 3D bin picking, quality inspection, sorting and assembly.
why_it_matters_hint: A leading industrial robot maker says new software makes camera-guided robots much faster to set up, but the figures are its own best-case claims.
notes: Press-release style trade article; the 90% and 50% figures are ABB's "up to" claims with no independent test or customer example.
